items.title: A friend told me today, “you live a big life” and it stopped me in my tracks
items.summary:
A friend told me today, “you live a big life” and it stopped me in my tracks. 

It made me think about how all the small and big daily choices I’ve made over the many many years have led to me creating this life that I’m passionately, wildly obsessed with. 

It made me reflect on how my entire life has changed in the span of 1 year when I decided to go all in with astrology. 

When I consciously decided and “locked in” that I was going to make my first million….as an astrologer. (Which most astrologers will say is crazy and I say, “um how?? Why??”)

When I decided to leave the United States and move abroad to start my life over. 

When I decided to leave my 15 years of being a performer on stage to pursuing entrepreneurship. Bought the credit card that day. Launched the website that night. 

I move fast 🏎️ 

And it’s why I live such a big life. 

Every single choice has the power to change your life. 

And this Pisces lunar eclipse today has me looking back at where I was a year ago, and the year before that like “🤯🤯🤯🤯”

isn’t that SO FUN?! 🎢 

Whatever you were doing or thinking about in September 2024, take a look at that. 

So 👏 much 👏 has 👏 changed.

And thank God for that ⚡️

Your entire life can change in a year. 

Take some time to connect with the sun, the stars and the trees today. Sleep more, pray more, dream more. Sometimes the best answers, the best wisdom, comes from subconscious. And Uranus is involved with this eclipse so…⚡️

What house is this affecting you? Comment BIRTH CHART if you don’t know how to find where Pisces is in your chart. I gotchu!! ⤵️
